messages.title: Help shape the future of Hermes
messages.body:
We're re-evaluating the Hermes roadmap and we'd like your feedback. Tell us which fixes, features and platforms you think should be prioritized next.

https://github.com/MrOz59/Hermes/issues/57

messages.title: NVIDIA users: help test zero-copy capture
messages.body:
We're working on NVENC capture without CPU copies, but have no NVIDIA card to validate it. If you stream from an NVIDIA GPU on Linux, please try the experimental/nvidia-zero-copy branches of Hermes and Hermes-KMS.

Start with the Hermes-KMS checks (hermes-import-cache-check needs no compositor), then stream with HERMES_KMS_EXPERIMENTAL_NVENC_DMABUF=auto. Both pull requests list the steps.

This is experimental: use a test session, as the NVIDIA driver may crash. Without the variable, Hermes keeps the current CPU copy.

Please post your results with GPU, driver, kernel and KWin versions on:
https://github.com/MrOz59/Hermes/pull/66
https://github.com/MrOz59/Hermes-KMS/pull/15
